title: Already In Requested Mode or State plan revised as SendUnitData connected transport seed
purpose: Add a distinct connected-data parser entry point using the documented Connected Address Item and Connected Data Item CPF combination, broadening transport coverage beyond discovery and unconnected paths.

messages.label: SendUnitData with Connected Address Item and Connected Data Item

expected_behavior: Peer parses a valid SendUnitData frame, recognizes the connected CPF item pairing, and routes the connected data item through the connected-data handling path.
constraints_preserved: Nonzero session handle used for connected transport context
Command-specific payload includes interface handle and timeout fields
First item is Connected Address Item with 4-byte connection identifier
Second item is Connected Data Item with 4-byte minimal payload
issue_safety_notes: PK-only transport-coverage seed. The title references a status phrase from planning, but the wire image is only a safe structural connected-data analogue and does not attempt to provoke or assert any specific status response.
